summary.name: Funkwhale
summary.one_liner: Funkwhale is a modern, web-based, multi-user music server; this page is only an Anubis bot-check placeholder from its GitLab mirror, so little was verified about the project itself.
use_cases: streaming audio through a web browser
summary.what_it_does: The page itself is an Anubis proof-of-work bot-protection interstitial on the dev.funkwhale.audio GitLab site, not project content. It states that Anubis uses a Hashcash-style proof-of-work scheme to make mass scraping more expensive. The page meta description says to get involved in Funkwhale development. The awesome-selfhosted listing describes Funkwhale as a modern, web-based, convivial, multi-user and free music server under BSD-3-Clause, written in Python.
notable: Multi-user music server with a web interface
Written in Python and licensed BSD-3-Clause
Listed in awesome-selfhosted under audio streaming
caveats: Page content was blocked by an Anubis bot check, so features could not be verified from this page
Browser plugins such as JShelter must be disabled to access this domain
